evals.prompt: Plan a production Galileo On-Prem deployment on our Kubernetes cluster, including Galileo Stack, Agent Control, Luna Studio, GPU inference, monitoring, SSO, and an air-gapped registry. Do not change the cluster yet.
evals.expected_output: A non-mutating intake and immutable parent orchestration packet that routes each deployment surface to exactly one canonical child and keeps production readiness blocked until chart-runtime, infrastructure, approval, model, trace, backup/restore, and soak evidence exists.
assertions: Selects galileo-on-prem-kubernetes-setup as the deployment router.
Asks for or uses the Galileo instance console URL and exact entitled artifact paths/digests.
Routes Stack, Agent Control, Luna Studio, and air-gap work to their distinct on-prem child skills.
Does not call Helm, Kubernetes, SSH, registries, Galileo APIs, or child mutation commands.
Does not claim production readiness from a render or Helm success.

evals.prompt: Run full Galileo On-Prem deployment coverage against this Stack child runtime-inventory JSON and tell me what is unclassified.
evals.expected_output: Runs the parent --coverage path, compares all nine required chart-runtime categories against stable matrix IDs and exact owners, and returns the four coverage arrays with a nonzero result if any item/category is missing, unowned, duplicated, or unclassified.
assertions: Requires the runtime inventory to bind the exact Stack chart SHA-256.
Checks dependency, schema/flag, image, CRD, hook/migration, cluster object, API kind, service/route, and persistence categories.
Returns uncovered, unowned, duplicate_mutation_owners, and unclassified_runtime_inventory arrays.
Does not treat static documentation rows as complete runtime coverage.

evals.prompt: Use the Galileo Kubernetes parent to install the Stack now with --atomic and --reuse-values, then roll back automatically if a migration fails.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the request at the parent boundary and routes any later approved lifecycle work to galileo-on-prem-stack-setup without executing it.
assertions: Rejects install/apply/upgrade/rollback as parent mutation modes.
Does not use --atomic, --reuse-values, automatic rollback, or upgrade --install.
Explains that failures must remain available for diagnosis and migrations require compatibility review.

evals.prompt: Configure projects, datasets, scorers, model providers, and Galileo Observe dashboards on our already-running instance.
evals.expected_output: Does not activate the Kubernetes deployment router; routes to galileo-platform-setup because the request is running-tenant product configuration.
assertions: Does not select galileo-on-prem-kubernetes-setup.
Routes to galileo-platform-setup.
Does not request Kubernetes chart or CRD inputs.

evals.prompt: Our three-node CPU-only MicroK8s lab has no StorageClass or load balancer. Can you mark the Galileo deployment production ready because all three nodes are Ready?
evals.expected_output: Refuses the production-ready claim, renders or explains a blocked doctor result, and identifies storage, routing, capacity/topology, exact-chart runtime, approval, persistence, GPU-live, and production completion evidence gaps.
assertions: Ready Kubernetes nodes alone do not satisfy Galileo readiness.
Keeps the CPU-only lab GPU result static-only.
Uses the documented runner label galileo-node-type=galileo-runner.
Requires a production-like topology and three-day incident-free soak before production-ready.

evals.prompt: Use the recommended galileoctl browser UI installation method for the Galileo platform, but do not change the cluster from the parent workflow.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes galileoctl UI/CLI as official Method A and renders a non-mutating, source-backed handoff for the pinned galileoctl and umbrella releases with preflight, dry-run, RBAC, approval, audit, and post-deploy gates.
assertions: Classifies galileoctl UI and CLI together as recommended official Method A, one of four platform installation methods.
Keeps pinned galileo-stack Helm CLI as the deterministic directly automated method and retains galileoctl, deployment-script, and step-by-step paths as reviewed alternatives.
Routes galileoctl installation and validation to galileo-on-prem-stack-setup with separate console-release, RBAC, authentication, dry-run, and audit gates.
Does not execute any live install from the parent skill.
